title: Repeal of the Consumer Protection Act, 1986
description: The Consumer Protection Act, 1986 is hereby repealed

content.general_rule: Before the commencement of this Act, consumer protection was governed by the Consumer Protection Act, 1986
content.exception: The Consumer Protection Act, 1986 is hereby repealed
